newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's June trade swings to $97 mln surplus.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's June trade swings to $97 mln surplus.

text.p: South Korea's customs-cleared trade swung to a $97 million surplus in June from a $426 million deficit a year-ago period, a trade ministry official said on Tuesday.
The ministry's provisional figures showed exports in June at $12.346 billion while imports stood at $12.249 billion, the official told Reuters by telephone.
This marks the first surplus since December 1994.
The ministry will officially announce the figures this afternoon with the details of the June trade account.
